title: Carry experience across sessions, re-establish target state
description: Remember which requests produced which replies, but scope transient state and partial progress to the session that produced them. Use run-scoped notes for tentative behavioral patterns, and session notes for current workflow state.
when_to_try: Starting a fresh target conversation or planning a dependent follow-up.
prerequisites: Session identifiers on observations and evidence references.
limitations: A pattern seen once remains a hypothesis about this target.
A run-scoped note does not establish that authorization, identity or prior changes persist across target sessions.

sources.note: Fresh target conversations reset state while the attacker retains its experience.
